_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to repos.json and edit. fork-sync discovery config. Castellyn seeds its durable copy (%APPDATA%\castellyn\forks.json) from repos.json on first run, and the Forks tab edits it from there afterwards. A missing repos.json is normal: nothing is scanned until you register something, either here or in the Forks tab.
_roots: Folders whose immediate subdirectories are each treated as a git repo. Use for a directory where you keep several clones.
_paths: Explicit paths to individual FORK clones (a repo with an upstream you want to track).
_ownPaths: Explicit paths to your OWN repos (no upstream). Reported for PR/CI status and merged-branch cleanup only — never fast-forwarded from an upstream, never remote-normalized.
_timeouts: Seconds. Omit both to use the built-in 120 / 60.
